response.overview: Having longed since childhood to become a football idol, Zé António, with a medical certificate forged by an agent from a certain club, begins playing this “violent sport,” abandoning his job as a metalworker, his home, his family, and his fiancée. He allows himself to be corrupted in the cabarets, accompanied by a seductive woman, and ruins his public image as a football player. Later, ignored by the crowd, he ends up as a railroad conductor, reconciling with his father and returning to the woman who had always loved him...
response.title: Bola ao Centro
